name: Chihaya
source:
Chihaya is a god of misfortune who lives near the school, taking care of the school greenhouse after [url=/c796]Akiho[/url] died. She is very timid and constantly apologizes, and very unfamiliar with the modern life, having been sealed in a tree for the past 500 years.

[From [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2009/08/28/moshimo-ashita-ga-harenaraba-review/]Calamitous Intent's review[/url]]
